verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS gateway and management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only proxying, governing and observing AI traffic: LLM routing, AI CLI proxying, A2A routing and MCP conversion. None of it documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to; those gateway features are adjacent, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
